# FlushMouse <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzBasic](BlitzBasic) · [Mouse](BlitzBasic-Mouse)

</div>


```blitzbasic
FlushMouse:Void
```

## Description

Forgets mouse button presses that nobody has looked at yet: the queue behind [GetMouse](GetMouse) and [WaitMouse](WaitMouse), the presses counted for [MouseHit](MouseHit), and the movement counted by the speed functions. Use it before a screen that waits for a click so that earlier clicks do not skip it, but not in the main loop.

## Differences

* The Device argument is a BlitzLLVM extension: the original has no such argument and only knows one mouse.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Graphics 320, 240, 0, 2
SetBuffer BackBuffer()
Text 10, 10, "Click as often as you like..."
Flip
Delay 2000
FlushMouse
Cls
Text 10, 10, "Old clicks are gone. Click once more."
Flip
WaitMouse
```
